name: Spare Room
source:
A complete love story from start to finish.

Erik (45) chooses to revisit old memories, one about his partner Lewis (44). As his home is filled to the brim with mementos of their love, he must make peace with what was left with him.

[From [url=https://commanderwyn.itch.io/spare-room]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个完整的爱情故事，从头到尾。

埃里克（45岁）选择重温旧日记忆，其中一段是关于他的伴侣刘易斯（44岁）的。由于他的家里堆满了他们爱情的纪念品，他必须接受剩下的一切。

[来自[url=https://commanderwyn.itch.io/spare-room]Itch.io[/url]]
